remarks: Are you on the hunt for rental accommodations? Look no further! Take a deep breath and unwind in this sunny unit situated in the heart of downtown Stamford. A commuter's paradise, this location offers easy access to public transportation and is just a stone's throw away from the Ridgeway shopping center, grocery stores, restaurants, and fitness centers. This 1bed/1bath unit boasts a spacious and well-lit interior with beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The monthly rent includes cooking gas and hot water, and you'll even have the convenience of two parking spots. Please note that move-ins are only permitted on weekdays. Experience comfort and convenience at its finest - schedule a viewing today!
